label: Berlin Myths
lede: The Berlin stories people repeat that are wrong, half right, or stranger than the version you heard. I check each one against the record and say which part survives.

lead.title: Rebuilt Buildings in Berlin: How Old Its Famous Landmarks Actually Are
lead.excerpt: A palace finished in 2020. A medieval quarter finished in 1987. A chariot cast in 1958. Of the fourteen landmarks between the Staatsoper and Alexanderplatz, only four are still the material they were built from. Here is what each one really is, and four checks that let you tell on site without knowing a single date.
lead.alt: The reconstructed baroque facades and dome of the Humboldt Forum in central Berlin
lead.line: A palace finished in 2020. A medieval quarter finished in 1987.
